task.description:
Implement API-08 (Bearer token auth) per the design at src/design/api-auth.md.

Implementation files:
1. src/api/middleware/auth.zig — AuthToken type, Role enum, AuthContext, AuthResult, init() (startup validation), authenticate() middleware
2. Extend src/api/errors.zig — add problemUnauthorized() (401) and problemForbidden() (403) constructors
3. Update src/api/api_mod.zig — export auth middleware

Key requirements:
- All endpoints require Bearer token in Authorization header
- Missing/invalid token → HTTP 401 + WWW-Authenticate: Bearer header
- Valid token but insufficient role → HTTP 403
- BPM_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN env var: accepted as PLATFORM_ADMIN in non-production; refuses to start in production
- Token validation on every request, no caching beyond request lifetime

Security rules:
- No SQL string interpolation
- All allocating functions accept std.mem.Allocator
- No I/O in src/engine/transition.zig
- Error types in per-module error sets

Acceptance criteria:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
acceptance_criteria: src/api/middleware/auth.zig implements init() and authenticate() per design
BPM_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN: startup validation in production, accepted in dev

result.summary: Implemented API-08 Bearer token auth middleware. Created src/api/middleware/auth.zig with Role enum, AuthContext, AuthResult, init(), authenticate(), and deinit(). Extended src/api/errors.zig with problemUnauthorized() (401) and problemForbidden() (403). Updated src/api/api_mod.zig to export auth middleware. Updated build.zig to provide pool module as named import for api test builds. All DB queries use $1 prepared statements. Token hash comparison is constant-time. BPM_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN validated at startup: fatal error in production, accepted as PLATFORM_ADMIN in dev. 401 responses include Problem Details body. zig build and zig build test both exit 0.
result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGNER for API-08 auth middleware test spec
